style: 既存の彩色人物画に合わせた腰までの透過画像。肖像・立ち絵で同じ画像を共用。外見・年代・服装は今回の美術設定で、原文の既定情報ではない。

files.prompt_en: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: an isolated transparent dialogue character cutout for a Japanese dungeon RPG, delivered as a PNG with genuine transparent alpha everywhere outside the person. Single adult character, centered waist-up composition, complete hair silhouette and both hands visible, lower edge below the belt, generous empty transparent margins at both sides and above. Vertical portrait canvas, 1024 by 1536 pixels. Detailed painted game illustration with tactile linen and worn leather, clean readable facial features, muted earth colors, soft warm light from upper left, eye-level three-quarter view. The whole surrounding area is fully empty transparency, including the space beside the shoulders and head. Plain unlettered clothing surfaces. Subject: Mea, a caretaker of a small private memorial, an adult woman in her late fifties with a broad sturdy build, medium brown skin, a rounded face with fine lines beside her eyes, deep brown eyes, and thick ash-brown hair streaked with silver, neatly drawn back into a low braided bun. Her attentive expression carries thoughtful concern, with level brows and relaxed lips as she listens to someone reconsidering a shared custom. She wears a plain muted plum wool waistcoat with simple small buttons over a warm grey linen blouse, long sleeves gathered at her wrists, an olive-brown woven waist sash, and a practical dark skirt visible below the waist. Both empty hands are fully visible near her waist, loosely held together with relaxed fingers. Her shoulders are settled and her posture open. Her low silver-streaked bun, broad silhouette, plum waistcoat and olive sash make her identity clear.
files.prompt_ja: 用途：日本語ダンジョンRPGの透過会話人物画。人物以外の全域に透明なアルファを持つPNG。成人1人を中央に配置し、髪の輪郭と両手が入り、帯の下で自然に終わる腰までの構図。左右と頭上に十分な透過余白を取る。1024×1536の縦画面。麻と使い込まれた革の質感を備えた緻密な彩色ゲーム人物画。顔の特徴が読み取りやすく、落ち着いた土色、左上からの柔らかい暖色光、目の高さからの斜め正面。肩や頭の周囲も完全な透過。衣服は文字のない無地。人物はメア、小さな私設追悼台の世話役。50代後半の成人女性。幅広でしっかりした体格、褐色の肌、目尻に細い皺のある丸い顔、濃い茶色の目。銀色が交じった豊かな灰褐色の髪を後ろへ整え、低い位置の編み込みのお団子にまとめる。眉は水平で唇の力を抜き、皆で続けてきた習わしを考え直す相手に耳を傾けるように、思案と気遣いのある表情。暖かな灰色の麻のブラウスの上に、小さな簡素なボタンのついた無地のくすんだプラム色のウールの胴着。長袖の袖口を手首に寄せ、オリーブブラウンの織物の腰帯を巻き、腰の下に実用的な濃色のスカートが見える。空の両手全体を腰の近くに見せ、指の力を抜いてゆるく合わせる。肩を落ち着かせ、相手に向き合う開いた姿勢。銀色が交じった低いお団子、幅広の輪郭、プラム色の胴着とオリーブ色の腰帯で人物を明確にする。
